scope: Offline classification only; no endpoint probes, provider requests, activation or audit restart.

categoryPolicy.1: A documented structured search mechanism exists at system level; installation enablement and library scope may remain untested.
categoryPolicy.2: An identifiable shared website JSON/HTML request implementation exists, with maintenance and verification work still possible.
categoryPolicy.3: Bespoke/unmapped method or platform without an established shared request implementation. Can include working custom methods.
categoryPolicy.4: Every frozen route has a saved access/policy/transport blocker. Not proof of permanent failure.

initialReleasePolicy: Both categories 1 and 2 may qualify after supported relevant searches in the correct library and usable item links are verified. Classification itself releases nothing.
documentationStatus: External URLs are system documentation reviewed during the preceding planning research; they are not new per-library endpoint tests or archived fresh responses in this classification.

koha.method: Built-in OPAC RSS/XML search plus public MARCXML record lookup
koha.nextAction: Later verify the permitted RSS query, paging, native identity and local holdings on each selected installation. Five saved installations demonstrate this route.
koha.claimScope: system-level access candidate; per-library enablement, scope and results require verification

requestLead.qualification: Five saved provider probes only; RSS search and REST record access are separate capabilities.

requestLead.qualification: Official manual lead, not a request performed here. Confirm SRU version and institution holdings support in a later pilot.
